feeds.description: The International Society of Hypertension (ISH) is committed to promoting and encouraging the advancement of scientific research and knowledge and its application to the prevention and management of stroke in hypertension and related cardiovascular diseases around the world. Follow this blog for more updates.

feeds.title: Medical News » Hypertension
feeds.description: Hypertension or high blood pressure can lead to heart disease, stroke, and death and is a major global health concern. A range of risk factors may increase the chances of a person developing hypertension, but can it be prevented. Follow this blog to find out what causes hypertension, its symptoms, types, and how to prevent it.
